description: Implementation of the PingPayloadDecoder class for decoding HTTP/2 PING frame payloads in the quiche HTTP/2 library.

classes.name: PingPayloadDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for handling HTTP/2 PING frame payloads, including starting, resuming, and handling decoding status.

methods.name: StartDecodingPayload
methods.description: Begins decoding the payload of a PING frame, handling the case where payload is fully in buffer.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding the payload when not completed in the initial attempt.

methods.name: HandleStatus
methods.description: Handles the decoding status, finalizing the decoding process or reporting errors.
